- There's a `tmp/` directory and a `workspace/` directory which are safe sandboxes.
- The safest approach is to create a fresh Go module in `./tmp/minecraft/` (or any subdirectory under `tmp/`) so it doesn't interfere with the existing agent project.

I'll use `tmp/` as the temporary work tree.
